messages:
Lena (Marketing): Heads-up — starting a 2-week sprint to rework the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing stack. Goal: one coherent narrative that graduates users down the funnel without duplicating pages. Draft plan below, looking for input.

Marco (Growth): love it. Quick Q — do we keep separate hero CTAs or a single hero with product-mode selector?

Lena (Marketing): thinking single hero with clarifying subhead + mode selector. Main CTA should be "Get started" for Hosted, "Contact sales" for Dedicated, "Request a private trial" for Private. But open to ideas.

Priya (Content): +1 to single hero. We should optimize copy for intent: trial-first for Hosted, SLA/commit language for Dedicated, compliance/ops language for Private. I'll prototype microcopy variants.

Evan (Product): want to avoid promising identical metrics across modes. Can we add a subtle performance band or a short line like: "Latency & cost tradeoffs vary by mode — see customers & benchmarks" linking to a benchmark page?

Sofia (Design): I'll mock a hero that supports the selector and microcopy. Also propose a persistent top-of-page banner for "benchmarks & case studies" so power users can jump straight to technical proof.

Marco (Growth): For launch posts / webinar planning — can we tie a webinar to the Dedicated case studies, and use benchmarks as the lead magnet for Hosted? That gives us two inbound tracks.

Lena (Marketing): Good split. Routing idea: inbound form has a hidden field for "mode interest" based on CTA clicked. Then we map to different lead queues: Hosted -> Product Demo (self-serve nurture), Dedicated -> Sales AE, Private -> Solutions Eng.

Priya (Content): Draft hero microcopy ideas (short): 
- Hosted: "Start building with low-friction hosted inference."
- Dedicated: "Reserved GPU capacity with SLA-backed throughput."
- Private: "Air-gapped and VPC-ready inference for regulated data."
I'll put tone variants (developer-focused vs exec-focused).

Evan (Product): For benchmark narratives, suggest two levels: 1) quick snapshot metric box (p95 latency, tokens/sec, $/1M tokens) and 2) expandable deep-dive with methodology and config. Ops folks will want the latter.

Sofia (Design): UX note — metric box should be copyable and shareable (tweet/report). Add small copy: "Configuration: 8x A100, q4_8_quant, seq=1024" so it's reproducible.

Marco (Growth): Webinar plan draft: "Running inference at scale: costs, latency, and routing" — target PLG and infra leads. Use benchmark as gated asset; run 1 live + 1 on-demand. Who owns speaker lineup?

Lena (Marketing): Priya + Evan to co-present. Marco to run promotion funnel + ad creative. Sofia to produce slides. I'll schedule the kickoff tomorrow.

Priya (Content): Also proposing a short canonical microcopy table for engineering docs and SDK pages so language matches the landing page. I'll spin that and link to `/docs/messaging-guidelines`.

Evan (Product): One technical ask: ensure we don't use absolute numbers without context. Add a footnote component for "testbed config" and a link to the full eval harness repo.

Lena (Marketing): Routing detail — quick mapping snippet for eng: 
```
if cta == 'Hosted': queue = 'product-nurture'
elif cta == 'Dedicated': queue = 'sales-ae'
else: queue = 'solutions-eng'
```

Marco (Growth): nice. Also flag: we should instrument UTM+click events so we can A/B hero copy. Experiment 1: "Start building" vs "Production-ready inference" for Hosted hero.

Sofia (Design): I'll create two visual treatments for the A/B. One emphasizes speed (metrics-first), other emphasizes trust (logos + SLAs).

Lena (Marketing): Next steps: Priya to drop microcopy drafts by EOD Monday, Sofia to upload hero mockups by Tuesday, Marco to wire growth funnel + webinar microsite by Wednesday, Evan to prepare benchmark summary. We'll reconvene Friday for the copy freeze.

ops-bot: Reminder — marketing sprint board created: https://app.track/sprints/ri-copy-stack-23 :thumbsup:

Marco (Growth): All clear. Anything we need from legal for Private page claims?

Evan (Product): Legal may want to review any explicit SLA or compliance claims. I'll loop them in after Priya's first pass.

Priya (Content): I'll include optional legal-friendly phrasings in the doc.

Lena (Marketing): Great — thanks team. Small ask: keep hero lines under 8 words where possible.

Sofia (Design): noted.

Lena (Marketing): I'll post a follow-up with the kickoff calendar invite and deliverable checklist.

Marco (Growth): Thanks — excited to iterate on this. :rocket:
